_scope_note: Candidate only. Review and deploy by hand with candidate-rollout.py; never applied automatically. Adds asks for the common direct merge shapes (gh pr merge, rtk gh pr merge, gh -R/--repo ... pr merge, gh api .../merge, GraphQL mergePullRequest, the GitHub MCP merge tool) so the broad merge allows no longer run silently for them. Prefix rules cannot cover every shape; others fall to the Auto Mode classifier. Adds no allow and no autoMode change; the validating runner's allow rule stays an owner step.
